# Rows and columns of a data frame, chosen as illumex chooses them

The data an illumex function would use after `subset` and `cols`: the
rows first, then the columns. Row names keep the original row numbers
(or the original names, if the data had them), and the attribute
`"ilm_select"` says what was chosen.

## Usage

``` r
ilm_subset(
  data,
  subset = NULL,
  subset_negate = FALSE,
  subset_fixed = FALSE,
  cols = NULL,
  cols_negate = FALSE,
  cols_fixed = FALSE
)
```

## Arguments

- data:

  A data frame.

- subset, subset_negate, subset_fixed:

  Which rows; see
  [ilm_selection](https://huttoncp.github.io/illumex/reference/ilm_selection.md).

- cols, cols_negate, cols_fixed:

  Which columns; see
  [ilm_selection](https://huttoncp.github.io/illumex/reference/ilm_selection.md).

## Value

A data frame.

## See also

[ilm_selection](https://huttoncp.github.io/illumex/reference/ilm_selection.md),
[`ilm_sample()`](https://huttoncp.github.io/illumex/reference/ilm_sample.md).

d <- ilm_sim()
